title: Finite evaluation of the geometric scalar mate before ramified balancing
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite extensions and $i:E\to F$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra map. Let $e\geq1$ satisfy $(t)\mathcal O_F=(v^e)$ for the specified uniformizers [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $c=(j,p)$ a compactification, $S$ an $E$ derived reduction-system calculus, $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\widehat{\mathcal O_E})$, and $n\geq0$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Let $a_M$ be scalar extension of supportModel followed by the proper/open scalar comparison on the reduced $E$ input, stopping before reductionBalancing [def-pur-native-constant-support-model, def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates]. Let $\sigma_M=\operatorname{scalarImageEvaluation}_M$ be the independently constructed constant-image/tensor/local-reduction/finite-balancing/restriction transport [def-pur-strict-scalar-finite-evaluation-transport], and let $\lambda_M=\operatorname{sourceEvaluation}_M$ [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data]. Then $\sigma_M\circ e_n(a_M)=\operatorname{Res}(\operatorname{finiteTensorMap}_M)\circ\lambda_M$, where the restriction is to constant $\mathcal O_F$ coefficients and finiteTensorMap has exponents $n+1,e(n+1)$ [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. This equation uses no $F$ reduction calculus, ramified reductionBalancing, image reindexing, target supportModel, or targetEvaluation.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of Step 7 of lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate, separating the geometric mate from the ramified reduction isomorphisms.

from.place: The finite evaluation calculation in strict compact-support scalar comparison, Step 7.

proof.text: Compare supportModel followed by constant image evaluation with the native supportEvaluation. Transpose their proper parts under the finite geometric adjunction. Identity-on-sections ordinary restriction and normalized derived counits make the transposes equal. The open parts agree by the ordinary open unit normalization.

Transpose the evaluated proper scalar mate. The scalar-adjunction tensor-unit formula and proper counit give exactly the transpose of finite properComparison. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection identifies these maps.
On the open the open scalar comparison is tensor balancing, and off the open both modules are zero. Its exact localization is finite openComparison. This remains true on diagram resolutions.

The ordinary finite balancing commutes with these units and counits on each pure tensor, by its quotient coefficient formula. Its universal cochain equation gives the same derived balancing. Compose proper mate with proper image of the open map; naturality moves the reduction evaluation through them, leaving precisely the scalarImageEvaluation endpoint and finiteTensorMap. Localization extends the equation to every derived M. Positivity includes e=1,n=0; zero inputs and empty opens use the same identities.

theorem geometricScalar_finiteEvaluation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X) (e : ℕ)
    (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    (ev (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) Y n).map
        ((T l E F i Y).map ((supportModel l E c S).hom.app M) ≫
          (comparison l E F i c).app ((reduction l E X S).obj M)) ≫
        (scalarImageEvaluation l E F i c S e he hepos n).hom.app M =
      (sourceEvaluation l E F i c S e he hepos n).hom.app M ≫
        (positiveRestriction l F Y (e * (n + 1))
          (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))).map
          (PurCompactSupport.finiteTensorMap l E F i e he hepos n c M)
